traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Picramniaceae: leaves alternate; leaves compound; compound leaves pinnate; veins pinnate; stipules absent; plants dioecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in racemes or in panicles; flowers actinomorphic; perianth usually sepals and petals, sometimes tepals; fruit berry or samara; parts of each whorl 3 to 5 (-6); stamens 3 to 5 (-6); carpels 2 to 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
